description: This file defines the Monitor class and related nested classes and data structures for a plugin system that monitors memory and operational status of components. It includes class definitions, JSON serialization structures, and interface implementations for plugin lifecycle and web interactions.

classes.name: Monitor
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing monitoring functionalities, lifecycle, and web interface.

classes.name: Monitor::MetaData
classes.description: Holds memory and process measurement data.

classes.name: Monitor::Data
classes.description: JSON serializable data structure representing monitor data.

classes.name: Monitor::MetaData::Measurement
classes.description: Stores min, max, average, and last measurements for a metric.

classes.name: Monitor::Config::Entry
classes.description: Configuration entry for each observable, including restart info.

classes.name: Monitor::MonitorObjects
classes.description: Manages collection of monitor objects, handles notifications, and dispatches evaluation jobs.

classes.name: Monitor::MonitorObject
classes.description: Represents individual monitored entity, tracks operational and memory status, handles restart logic.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the service context.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.

methods.name: endpoint_restartlimits
methods.description: Handles restart limits configuration via JSON RPC.

methods.name: endpoint_resetstats
methods.description: Resets monitoring statistics via JSON RPC.

methods.name: get_status
methods.description: Retrieves current status of monitored entities.

methods.name: event_action
methods.description: Triggers an event action, such as restart or stop.
